row_guide: Top: five large two-story villa colorways (orange/brown/burgundy/red/blue roofs) with porch+balcony. Upper-mid: modular chimneys, round attic windows, roof windows, solar panels, wall props (sconces, plaques, shuttered windows), lemonade stands. Mid-right: toy/playhouses, basketball hoops, seesaws, spring riders, sandboxes. Mid-lower: trampolines, yard trees/stumps/flowers/bushes, stepping stones, logs, hanging flower boxes, potted plants, picket/rail fencing, EV bollards, armchairs. Lower band0 / band1 top: picnic blankets and picnic props (baskets, coolers, food). Band1 (y768–912): complete treehouse with tire swing, trunk+deck base, cabin module, ladders, picnic/toolbox blankets, bottle/fruit scatter.
